description: Challenge: Conventional balance-sheet banks pulled back on rent-stabilized collateral under tight acquisition timelines. Execution: Engineered a 36-month non-recourse floating-rate bridge loan with two six-month extension options across four Central Brooklyn buildings.

Challenge: Sponsor required 85% of the equity check without ceding day-to-day construction and leasing control. Execution: Sourced a single family office LP partner structured with a 20% promote above an 8% preferred return hurdle.

Challenge: Class B office basis reset with zero in-place residential cash flow during gut renovation. Execution: Placed a 24-month non-recourse debt-fund facility with a 12-month extension and completion guarantee covering full conversion through residential lease-up.

Challenge: Sponsor needed to extract trapped equity and fund capex without disturbing an existing below-market fixed-rate senior mortgage. Execution: Closed a co-terminous preferred equity tranche at 12.5% current pay with no senior refinance required.

Challenge: Strict Affordable New York delivery milestones and interest-reserve sizing in a volatile rate environment. Execution: Cleared a 30-month regional bank construction facility with a built-in mini-perm conversion option at stabilization.

Challenge: Senior bank proceeds capped at 60% LTC, leaving a $14M gap in the last-mile conversion budget. Execution: Placed an 18-month subordinate mezzanine tranche with a NYC family office credit platform, pushing combined leverage to 83% LTC.
